environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with default task definition. Container runs as root with default Linux capabilities. ALB forwards all traffic directly to container port 8080. No request filtering or input validation middleware. IAM task role has s3:*, logs:*, and ssm:GetParameter permissions. Security group allows inbound on port 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.
